_about: Atlas's designer list: video style -> its designer. Each entry is the designer skill path (relative to the Super Nova folder), or {"skill": <path>, "script": "none"} for a scriptless style. A plain path means the style needs a script. A row with a blank Style uses the default. A style whose name ends in "carousel" is a carousel style (output type carousel; 2026-10-27). A carousel style marked script none is a scriptless carousel: no topic angle from Echo, its designer picks its own idea (lifestyle story carousel, 2026-11-03); otherwise the topic angle is its script. _aliases maps an old style name to its current one ("carousel" was renamed "corporate carousel" on 2026-10-27), so old sheets still read.
